results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.
results.licenseInfo: CREDIT - It is requested, but not required, that the Indiana GIS Data Harvest Program be cited in any products generated from this data set. If citing, the following source citation language should be included: [Parcel Boundaries of Indiana 2021: Parcel Boundaries Maintained by County Agencies in Indiana, (Indiana Geographic Information Office, File Geodatabase, Polygon Feature Class), 20220201].
results.source: Megan R.L. Compton, Indiana Office of Technology, Indiana Geographic Information Officer

results.name: Taxlots_InsideBG
results.title: Taxlots - Inside Battle Ground
results.description:
This layer contains tax parcel (taxlot) boundaries falling within the corporate limits of the City of Battle Ground, Washington. The layer was derived by clipping the Clark County GIS Department's countywide Taxlots layer to the Clark County GIS Department's City Boundaries layer, retaining only parcels inside the city limit polygon. It was created to support callout maps used in 3 dashboards and 1 instant app / Road Moratorium, Street Preservation, Capital Projects and 811 Dig Utility Map, displaying in-city parcel geometry separately from out-of-city parcels for symbology and performance purposes.

Spatial Reference: NAD 1983 StatePlane Washington South FIPS 4602 (US Feet) 

Geometry Type: Polygon

results.name: ZS_Map_V2_WFL2
results.title: Zoning Search Zones CCSD
results.description:
The collected digital geographic school zone attendance boundaries for neighborhood schools at the elementary, middle and high school grade levels for the Clark County School District is provided for Clark County, Nevada residents for the purpose of determining neighborhood school boundary assignments. The staff at Demographics, Zoning & GIS (DZG) is responsible for analyzing enrollment trends within the Clark County School District, student demographics, monitoring residential developments, and managing classroom space needs in order to maintain a stable learning environment for our 290,000+ students in over 374 educational facilities.

The collected CCSD datasets are in turn organized into dataset groups by academic school year, each of which corresponds to a single school year for the geographic school zone attendance boundary.  The polygon shapes representing each of the school zone attendance boundary are reviewed by the Attendance Zone Advisory Commission (AZAC) annually to provide recommendations to the Clark County School Board of Trustees, and the Office of the Superintendent of Schools concerning any necessary changes, modifications, updates, or corrections to school zone attendance boundaries.
results.snippet: To determine which school a student will attend based on the residence of the student's parent or legal guardian.  CCSD Attendance boundaries follow existing streets, parcel boundaries, municipal boundaries, zipcode boundaries, flood control features, and the presumed future extensions of thoroughfares.
